description.value:
Whenever a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself casts a spell of 1st level or higher, you can take a Reaction and expend Resonance equal to the spell's level to redirect it. If you cannot pay the full cost, this feature fails and no Resonance is spent.

Redirect the spell as follows, based on its targeting:

  • Targeted Spell. If the spell targets one or more creatures, choose any number of those targets and replace each with a new target you can see. Each new target must be within the spell's normal range, measured from your position, and must satisfy the spell's normal targeting requirements.
  • Area Spell. If the spell has an Area of Effect, choose a new point of origin for the Area. The new origin must be within the spell's normal range, measured from your position.
  • Self-Range Spell. A spell with a Range of Self cannot be redirected.

The spell otherwise resolves normally at its new target(s) or Area, treating the original caster as its source for all rules purposes (Save DC, Spell Attack Bonus, damage, duration, and so on).

Not automated: spend the Resonance on the Resonance bar of your sheet (right-click: -1) and resolve the new targets or origin with your GM.

activation.condition: When a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself casts a Spell of 1st level or higher

source.custom: Fimblewood Academy homebrew, adapted from "Unblooded Sorcery" (2026).
